uris.description: Comma-separated AT-URIs, up to 50 (the notifications page size). Values beyond that are ignored. Mixed lexicons are expected: a notifications page holds zeen likes and collection likes together.

main.description: Cover thumbnails for a batch of zeen / collection URIs. Deliberately narrow -- URIs in, cover refs out -- so a notifications list can draw a preview per row without a round trip each. getCollection takes one uri and returns the whole record plus an item count; a zeen had no AppView read at all and getZeen goes to the author's PDS for every page's full text to find one cid.

cid.description: The cover blob. Absent when the subject has no cover image, or when a private collection's cover is withheld.

did.description: The repo the blob lives on, which is NOT always the subject's author -- a zeen page can hold another user's photo, and the CDN needs the owning repo.

title.description: The zeen's title or the collection's name, for a subject with no cover to fall back on.

collection.description: The subject's NSID: app.zeens.zeen or app.zeens.collection. The caller draws a zeen at its 1:1.414 page ratio and a collection square.

cover.description: One subject. Returned even when it has no cover image, so a caller can tell a subject with no picture from a URI it could not resolve.
